'''January 2000 Williston Park tournament (22 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Williston Park, New York on 22 January 2000. [[Bill Power]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d218">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-01-williston-park-new-york-1-22-00d218/ williston-park-new-york-1-22-00], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 1 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-01-williston-park-new-york-1-22-00d218/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Williston Park, New York
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Bill Power]]
